resources.string: On your computer, open Durham Listing Tracker and click Pair Mobile, then scan the code it shows.

1. On your computer, open Durham Listing Tracker and click Pair Mobile.

2. Click Show manual details, under the QR code.

3. Enter the server address and API key shown there, exactly as written. Sending them to your phone, for example in a message to yourself, saves typing them.
Couldn\'t connect. Check the server address and API key, and that Durham Listing Tracker is running on your computer.
Couldn\'t reach the server from that QR code. Make sure Durham Listing Tracker is running on your computer, then scan again.
That isn\'t a Durham Listings code. Scan the code shown under Pair Mobile in the desktop app.
The app will forget this server. To connect again, scan the QR code in the desktop app.
Make sure your computer is on and Durham Listing Tracker is running, then try again.
This address is incomplete. Copy the full server address from the desktop app: it ends with # followed by a long code.
